Preserves validation true after identity false, the other fields false, and ready false.

retained_diagnostics: Compare all five named fields separately against expected; a correct ready verdict cannot excuse incorrect or omitted observations.
Each evidence field has true and false outcomes, detecting single-field inversions and stuck values.
Every pair of evidence fields differs in retained cases, detecting copying another field.
Mixed cases contain true observations while ready is false, detecting collapse of all outputs to ready.
Single-failure cases detect readiness that ignores any required field; mixed cases reject OR readiness; all-pass rejects always-false readiness and exercises the positive conjunction.
True observations after false observations detect stopping at the first false.
Retaining every original input preserves input-specific faults, beyond the explicitly listed fault families.
Cases remain independent; no reliability draws or comparison arms are merged.
limits: Runnable synthetic case data; not executed. No safe scenario reduction satisfies the unrestricted requirement to preserve every faulty implementation distinguished by the originals: removing any original input permits an implementation that fails only on that input to escape detection. Thus all eight distinct inputs remain, plus the required ready-positive input. A smaller suite could cover the named fault families but would weaken that broader guarantee. One aggregate verdict cannot replace these cases because it loses input-specific fault detection and separately attributable field observations. Exact equality must include field presence and boolean types; false means observed failure. Absent/unknown inputs are outside scope. No skill files changed, no trials run, and no token savings measured or claimed.
